gloss: to bring in; to carry in

definitions.gloss: to bring in; to carry in
definitions.explanation: To bring something into a place, often where it might not normally be allowed.
To take a matter or dispute to a third party for resolution.

examples.japanese: {会場|かいじょう}に{持|も}ち{込|こ}む。
{仕事|しごと}を{家|いえ}に{持|も}ち{込|こ}まないようにしている。
examples.english: I try not to bring work home.

examples.japanese: {飲食物|いんしょくぶつ}の{持|も}ち{込|こ}みは{禁止|きんし}されています。
examples.english: Bringing in food and drinks is prohibited.

examples.japanese: {空港|くうこう}では{液体|えきたい}の{持|も}ち{込|こ}みに{制限|せいげん}がある。
examples.english: There are restrictions on bringing liquids into the airport.

examples.japanese: {外国|がいこく}から{許可|きょか}なく{動物|どうぶつ}を{持|も}ち{込|こ}むと、{法律|ほうりつ}で{罰|ばっ}せられることがある。
examples.english: If you bring animals in from abroad without permission, you may be punished by law.

examples.japanese: {問題|もんだい}を{裁判所|さいばんしょ}に{持|も}ち{込|こ}んだ。
examples.english: They took the matter to court.

examples.japanese: {相手|あいて}チームは{試合|しあい}を{延長戦|えんちょうせん}に{持|も}ち{込|こ}んだ。
examples.english: The opposing team forced the game into overtime.

examples.japanese: {話|はなし}し{合|あ}いで{解決|かいけつ}できず、{裁判|さいばん}に{持|も}ち{込|こ}むことになった。
examples.english: We couldn't resolve it through discussion, so it came to going to court.

examples.japanese: {個人的|こじんてき}な{問題|もんだい}を{職場|しょくば}に{持|も}ち{込|こ}むのはよくない。
examples.english: It's not good to bring personal problems into the workplace.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{自分|じぶん}では{決|き}められず、いつも{上司|じょうし}に{相談|そうだん}を{持|も}ち{込|こ}む。
examples.english: He can't decide on his own and always brings consultations to his boss.

notes:
{持|も}ち{込|こ}む is a transitive verb ({他動詞|たどうし}) formed from {持|も}つ (to hold) + {込|こ}む (into). It emphasizes bringing something into a space, often implying it requires permission or might be prohibited.

ASPECT (ている):
{持|も}ち{込|こ}んでいる indicates something has been brought in and remains there.

PARTICLE PATTERNS:
- [thing]を[place]に{持|も}ち{込|こ}む — to bring [thing] into [place]
- [matter]を[authority]に{持|も}ち{込|こ}む — to take [matter] to [authority]

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {会場|かいじょう}に{持|も}ち{込|こ}む (bring into a venue)
- {裁判|さいばん}に{持|も}ち{込|こ}む (take to court)
- {延長戦|えんちょうせん}に{持|も}ち{込|こ}む (force into overtime)

NOTE: The noun form {持|も}ち{込|こ}み is common in signs: {持|も}ち{込|こ}み{禁止|きんし} (no outside items allowed).
